key_insight: Globally optimal partition selection combined with entanglement-aware resynthesis can reduce quantum-circuit CNOT counts.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports block-based circuit optimization with objectives such as minimizing partition count or weighted execution cost.
method: Use integer linear programming to select partitions optimally over enumerated candidates and computed costs.
Resynthesize selected blocks using operator-Schmidt rank to exploit internal entanglement structure.
evidence_signal: Across 772 frozen local unitary targets, OSR yielded 741 verified syntheses versus BQSKit’s 617, matching or improving CNOT counts in all 617 jointly verified pairs.
watch_item: Optimality requires a proven-optimal ILP solution and is limited to enumerated candidates and computed costs; end-to-end comparisons also use different routing methods.
paper_title: Entanglement-Aware Quantum Circuit Optimization through Globally Optimal Partitioning
